headline: Uzbekistan Plans Private Sector Road and Bridge Concessions Worth $4 Billion
summary: Uzbekistan plans to hand over selected roads and bridges to private investors for construction, maintenance, and operation, with 131 potential projects worth $4 billion identified.
why: Public-private infrastructure concessions mobilize private capital and shift long-term maintenance obligations away from state budgets.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Opening transport infrastructure to private investment encourages foreign and domestic capital deployment.
